BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

2. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

4. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.

5. When learning Scaffolding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scaffolding.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Scaffolding.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scaffolding.

6. When learning Site Organisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Organisation.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Organisation.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Site Organisation.

7. When learning Appropriate Technology in Building, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Appropriate Technology in Building.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Appropriate Technology in Building.

8. When learning Roof Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Roof Construction.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Roof Construction.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Roof Construction.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Roof Construction.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

10. When learning Doors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Doors.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Doors.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Doors.

11. When learning Construction Hand Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Hand Power Tools.

12. When learning Domestic Water Supply, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Domestic Water Supply.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Domestic Water Supply.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Domestic Water Supply.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Domestic Water Supply.

13. When learning Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Windows.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Windows.

14. When learning Sanitary Appliances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Sanitary Appliances.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Sanitary Appliances.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Sanitary Appliances.

15. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

16. When learning Construction Plant, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Plant.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Plant.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Construction Plant.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Sanitary Appliances and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Drainage Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Building Construction Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Construction Hand Power Tools and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Construction Plant and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Site Organisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
